# Monmouth University

> Monmouth University is a comprehensive private institution in New Jersey offering undergraduate and graduate programs across multiple schools and colleges, with distinctive centers including the Bruce Springsteen Center and Urban Coast Institute.

Located in Long Branch, New Jersey, Monmouth University serves over 6,000 students and maintains a 59,000+ alumni network. The university emphasizes academic excellence, student support, and engagement through research centers focused on entrepreneurship, global understanding, and real estate.

- [Visit | Monmouth University | New Jersey](https://www.monmouth.edu/visit): Campus visit information including in-person tours and virtual visit options
